blocks.text: Ship toughness: the three damage layers (shields, armor, hull), plus deflectors, which soak a slice of every hit first. Pick a line and commit.

The Shields, Armor and Hull lines each add a share of a ship's total base HP to that layer, so small ships gain as much, in proportion, as big ones. The Deflectors line cuts each hit first: with all three.
Every ship gains extra shields, more with each tier.
Every ship gains extra armor, more with each tier.
Every ship gains extra hull, more with each tier.
Every ship shrugs off part of each hit before its shields see it, more with each tier.
Ships whose shields fall shed debris that blocks enemy shots.
Warships with failing shields pull back to recharge, then return to the fight.
